follow-up time: Median 89 days (range 6-510 days) for placental resorption in the successful group; median 30 days (range 0-95 days) for hysterectomy in the unsuccessful group
exposure: placenta previa on a cesarean delivery scar
Placenta previa on a cesarean delivery scar
Success of leaving the placenta in situ
outcome: Success of leaving the placenta in situ approach for PAS disorders
cohort: 613 women with placenta previa on a cesarean scar who underwent perinatal care at secondary- or tertiary-level perinatal centers in Japan between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2014
finding: Leaving the placenta in situ was successful in 69% of patients with PAS disorders, with placental resorption occurring postpartum; hysterectomy was performed in the remaining patients primarily due to hemorrhage and/or infection.
